rejected_sample_mutation: invalid/foreign/replay/capacity errors do not mutate control state; trusted interruption once per valid identity resets only both streak counters plus dedicated replay record and sanitized audit

sample_id_policy.allowed_characters: ASCII alphanumeric underscore period colon hyphen

trusted_interruption.conditions: valid payload, correct resource/source/rule_version/optional_rule, valid strictly later UTC, non-replayed sample, freshness!=fresh or health_status!=observed or signal not bad/good

s1_composition: S1_EQUIVALENCE_FIXTURE_ONLY; local PinnedS1Evaluator stand-in, not a runtime import

replay_registry_policy.valid_seen: separate; same ID across both registries is a collision
replay_registry_policy.corrected_valid_same_id: CONFLICTING_REPLAY; explicit correction protocol not implemented
replay_registry_policy.registry_full: INTERRUPTION_REGISTRY_FULL; freeze all new sample ingestion, no control mutation, never evict an interruption identity
replay_registry_policy.retention: until explicit reset/new lifecycle instance; no time-based pruning; max 256 identities per instance
replay_registry_policy.snapshot_restore: v2 persists registry, validates length and no overlap with valid-seen IDs
replay_registry_policy.legacy_v1: restore allowed only if no trusted interruption in legacy audit; otherwise reject as missing replay provenance
replay_registry_policy.limitations: not a durable/cryptographically trusted registry; no cross-process locking/restart persistence absent external snapshot; existing valid seen store still separately unbounded
